tagline: A drawing game: one stroke each, then watch the picture replay.
description:
Draw one line. Lift. Send it. That is the whole turn. Nobody else may draw until you do. After a round you name the picture, then it plays back as a loop of the strokes arriving, in order — a doodle a whiteboard will not play for you.

On your own it is you against the page: one stroke at a time, a stack of lines, a looping picture that is still there when you come back.

Want a studio? Press With friends, then press Invite in the bar above and send the link. Everyone who opens it sits around the same page. Whose turn it is sits on the paper. You cannot draw when it is not your turn.

This is not a whiteboard. A whiteboard lets anyone draw anything, anytime. One Stroke is the constraint — one line each — so the picture can only exist because several people opened the same file.
